name: Priscilla Umana
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 4

items.text: Priscilla Umana is an American Sign Language educational interpreter seeking Seat 4 on the Los Angeles Community College District Board of Trustees. She told the Los Angeles Times that her interpreting work has given her firsthand understanding of how different circumstances affect students. Her priorities include expanding affordable housing, work-study, and food aid; removing language and disability barriers; and cutting waste in the district budget while raising revenue through business partnerships.
